notes: Needs ruling: the Shu'ba remark «سمعت أبا عمار يذكر عن وكيع قال قال شعبة سفيان أحفظ مني» is a second saying with its own isnad; not read as a route of this saying
The opening «وقد روى يحيى بن سعيد القطان ...» repeats the tail of the same route without Muhammad b. Bashshar and names no other transmitter: a remark, not a variant group

Main route is Muhammad b. Bashshar's («حدثنا بذلك، محمد بن بشار حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد ...»), continued by «وهكذا ذكره يحيى بن سعيد ... عن علقمة بن مرثد ...»; Sa'd sits after Shu'ba in this route, while Tirmidhi's own remark says Shu'ba alone added him: the text is read as written
Sufyan's students omitting Sa'd, «وهو أصح», «وفي الباب» and Yahya's «ما أحد يعدل عندي شعبة» are remarks, not routes
